+title: 'AVK-8g AgentAuthView: change the sign-in card from glass to the content surface'
+---
+## Why
+
+D110 (b). The sign-in card shows in the thread below the conversation (`Connections/AgentLoginPrompt.swift` line 33, in `AgentThreadView`). It is a request card, as a permission card is. It is content, so it has no glass. Only its action buttons can use the glass button styles.
+
+## Files
+
+- `Sources/AgentViewKit/Connections/AgentAuthView.swift` line 267: `.glassEffect(theme.materialLevel.glass, in: .rect(cornerRadius: theme.radii.l))`.
+- Keep line 413: the operation buttons keep `.buttonStyle(.glass)`.
+
+## What to do
+
+- [ ] Replace line 267 with `agentContentSurface()` (AVK-8b).
+- [ ] Keep the accessibility label and the identifier (lines 268-270).
+
+## Acceptance
+
+- `AgentAuthView.swift` has no `.glassEffect`.
+- A test renders the card with a code-built connection over a backdrop of one unique color with `RenderedPixels`. No pixel of the backdrop color shows inside the card.
+- All tests in `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Connections/` pass.
+- Tests use Swift Testing. No clock, sleep, poll, retry, timeLimit or XCUITest. Each wait waits for a certain event. #avk-8
\ No newline at end of file
